visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and a dark watch on his left wrist, stands in an indoor domestic setting. He holds a compact green knife sharpener (Lansky QuadSharp) in his hands, using his index finger to point out the various sharpening slots and the ceramic honing rod on the side. The background consists of an off-white wall with a light switch and a small decorative sticker. (2) The man holds a large silver kitchen knife with a black handle. He attempts to slice a piece of white paper covered in black text to demonstrate the knife's dullness. The blade catches on the paper, creating jagged tears rather than clean cuts. He looks toward the camera while explaining the performance. (3) He places the green sharpener on the table and holds it firmly with his left hand. With his right hand, he pulls the kitchen knife's blade through the 17-degree carbide sharpening slot multiple times. The camera is at eye-level, capturing his focused facial expression and precise hand movements. (4) After the initial sharpening, he tests the knife on the paper again. The blade slices through the paper with significantly more ease, creating a straight, clean cut. He points at the resulting cut to show the improvement. (5) He demonstrates the honing process by using the white ceramic rod integrated into the side of the green device. He slides the blade's edge along the rod in a controlled, diagonal motion. He then returns to slicing the paper, demonstrating curved and more intricate cuts to prove the restored sharpness. (6) In the final phase, the man holds both the knife and the sharpener up toward the camera. He smiles slightly, concluding his demonstration. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout, and the camera maintains a stable, medium-shot framing on the man and his tools.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks in a calm, friendly, and informative voice. The background is nearly silent with a clean indoor room tone. No background music is present. (2) A sharp, abrasive tearing sound occurs as a knife blade catches and rips through paper. The speaker continues his explanation over this noise. (3) A distinct, rhythmic metallic scraping sound begins, signifying the knife blade being drawn through carbide sharpeners. The scraping has a high-frequency grating texture, occurring in short, deliberate strokes. (4) The tearing sound is replaced by a crisp, high-pitched 'zip' sound as the sharpened blade cleanly slices through the paper. The speaker's tone becomes more enthusiastic as he notes the difference. (5) A series of rapid metallic scrapes and paper rustling events occur as the demonstrator sharpens and tests the blade repeatedly. The sound events are dense and clearly defined against the silent background. (6) A smoother, higher-pitched honing sound is audible as the blade is swiped against a ceramic rod, followed by the effortless sound of paper being cut into fine strips. (7) The narrator provides final closing remarks with a confident and satisfied intonation as the video ends.
